summary: First test run for The Board Fundraising Game (BFG) — a new product on top of Nonprofit Board Builder. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing (game content GET/PUT admin auth, flow videos game_homepage/game_welcome, member profile CRUD, situation form entitlement-gated CRUD + complete, dashboard 403/200 branches, Stripe game-checkout session creation, google/session negative 401, existing member login/dashboard regression, cross-product support-request 403 regression, admin game customers list). Frontend: all listed BFG flows pass — homepage renders with all data-testids, goal + hero CTA redirects to /game/signup, signup creates member and navigates to /game/start, profile wizard prefills goal (750,000) and full name from signup, Review step shows unlock button + edit link + org summary + benefits, clicking bfg-unlock-btn successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Entitled member: /game/setup 9-step form works with checkbox toggle, Save & Continue advances, reload resumes at saved step, Back button works. /game/dashboard shows Welcome back name, $750,000 goal card, status card, tutorial toggle, 7 locked areas. Non-entitled member (module-tester) sees bfg-dashboard-denied. /fundraising-system still renders the OLD homepage ('Are These 3 Board Mistakes...') with 2 lead form fields. Admin /admin: new 'Fundraising Game' tab visible alongside all existing tabs (Board Applicants, Nonprofit Contacts, Blog Posts, Reference Library, Client Delivery, Strategic Planning, Funnel Numbers, Board Fix, Board Builder). Game content panel loads, Save Website Content shows saved indicator, videos + customers sections render. Existing Client Delivery and Board Builder tabs still render correctly. No regressions observed in old funnels or admin.

issues: Benefits section renders elements that do not match li/article selectors — bfg-benefits-section visible but internal item count returned 0. Cosmetic only, section is visible with content per bfg-benefits-heading. Consider adding a stable child data-testid like bfg-benefit-item-N for future E2E assertions.

critical_code_review_comments: game_routes.py: welcome email send is wrapped in try/except that swallows all exceptions AND marks welcome_email_sent=True only inside the try block after send — good. But the flag is set inside the try AFTER await send; if send fails, welcome_email_sent is never set so email will retry on every /game/claim call. This is intentional but should be logged (currently silent 'except Exception: pass').
game_routes.py update_game_content silently drops unknown keys but returns 422 only when NO recognised keys are provided; behaviour is fine and tested.
GameSituationPage tests confirm current_step persistence works but the model caps at le=20 while SITUATION_SECTIONS has 9 entries — acceptable headroom.

Ensure /game/claim origin_url is validated (currently used unescaped in URL string for HTML anchor tags; it IS wrapped with rstrip('/') but not html.escape on the href attribute). Minor XSS risk if attacker controls origin_url; low severity because member auth is required to hit the endpoint.
